class.name: HTMLAnimation
class.brief_description: Playback control for a CSS or scripted HTML animation.
class.description: Use [method HTMLLayout.get_animations] or [method HTMLElement.animate] to obtain a handle. Animation time uses the owning layout clock. [HTMLLabel] drives that clock using its [member HTMLLabel.animation_process_mode].

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns whether the playback handle still belongs to its active layout and target.

method.name: get_target
method.description: Returns the target element of the animation.

method.name: get_name
method.description: Returns the CSS animation name or the CSS transition property.

method.name: get_pseudo_element
method.description: Returns the target pseudo-element name, or an empty string for an element target.

method.name: get_duration
method.description: Returns the total active duration in seconds, including iterations.

method.name: get_current_time
method.description: Returns the playback position in seconds relative to the start of the animation clock.

method.name: set_current_time
method.description: Seeks to the given time in seconds and samples the effect.

method.name: play
method.description: Plays or resumes the current animation.

method.name: pause
method.description: Pauses at the current playback position.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Clears the effect and resets playback to idle.

method.name: finish
method.description: Seeks to the end in the current playback direction. An infinite forward animation cannot be finished.

method.name: reverse
method.description: Reverses the playback direction on the same layout clock.
